== Comparison with existing 2021 paper slip ==
Original 2021 PDF object xref91/mask90 was compared directly with Set7 xref31/mask30. Removing 8 exterior top pixels makes dimensions equal (745×352) but does not remove the differences: RGB mean absolute difference 21.5157; 13.035% pixels differ by more than 40. These metrics are supporting evidence; visible frame/type-bar/footer changes are shown in [[:File:V7-L-theyretrackingus-2021-2023-partial-layout-difference.png]]. The 2021 PDF printed text edition is 23 June 2021; the exact publication day of either partial has not been established. Existing full-face and historical gameplay fields remain unchanged.
